name: Daggers and Scythes
description: Two new weapons for every material

pages.title: Daggers
pages.text:
A **dagger** hits for less than a sword but swings faster.

**Backstab:** hitting a mob from behind deals 50%% more damage. Catch mobs while they're busy with something else.

pages.title: Scythes
pages.text:
A **scythe** is slow and heavy, and reaches half a block further.

**Wide Sweep:** a full-strength swing on the ground sweeps everything in reach in front of you for half the attack's damage. Sweeping Edge makes the sweep stronger.

**Reaping:** breaking a fully grown crop harvests the grown crops around it (3x3) and replants them. Sneak to break just one.

pages.title: Material Traits
pages.text: Weapon traits count for daggers and scythes too. A silver dagger still hits the undead harder, and an infernium scythe still sets mobs alight.
One ingot over a stick makes a dagger. Three ingots over two sticks make a scythe.
